traces.title: Looked closer, then ran
traces.note: Light fog. The detector listed two 'unknown' blobs (0.43, 0.41) and a faint YOLOX 'bear' (0.16). The agent passed over the higher-scoring blobs, checked the faint bear for motion (1.0 px, which its explanation overstates as 'high motion'), looked closer (bear 0.16 → 0.58) and escaped. The rule escaped too. Truth: a real bear.

traces.title: A deer, not a bear
traces.note: The rule escaped on map risk plus an unknown blob. The agent saw no motion, looked closer (still 'unknown'), and kept going. Truth: a grazing deer, so the agent avoided a false alarm.

traces.title: Failure in thick fog
traces.note: About 39 m visibility. The agent saw no motion, looked closer ('unknown' 0.56) and chose to regroup instead of escaping; the rule also regrouped. Truth: a real bear. In thick fog the agent missed 46 of 66 real threats and the rule missed 27.
